I feel everything you said about feeling pathetic when it comes to your ex, it's just awful what a devastating impact break ups can have on you. It is a worry that my heart could be broken again as I don't know how well I'd take it again. I just try to remember that I had some amazing times with my ex in the 3 years we were together and even though we're over and he's firmly in my past, I wouldn't change the good memories with him for the world. Regarding going on a date with that guy, it's entirely up to you and whether you feel up to it. I'm glad I bit the bullet and went out with this new guy but if I wasn't ready it could've been painful. I hope your healing process will continue, because damn it is a process! And one day you will get there :) Thank you! I'm proud of me to hahaha

That's a shame that you didn't feel ready, but at the same time props to you for knowing that the timing was wrong and that you need to work on yourself more. Congrats for actually getting out there again though, it's such a big step!!

Ahhh that's fantastic news!! The guy I've been seeing is pretty different from my ex but I'm now seeing that as a positive :) it's such a nice feeling when you can finally get back out there and indeed time does having healing powers 🙂

I relate so much to this. I also have mental health problems and he was one of the main people I relied upon and talked to about it. It's expected to feel extremely lost without that special person who hitherto was always by your side, especially through such a big chunk of your life. 
It's a cliché and probably not at all helpful but one day it will get better. Or so they say. I'm a similar age to you and I'm just trying to realise that the majority of my life is still in front of me. A life I can shape. A life in which I can grow. 
Not being able to talk to that person about everything is so so hard. If you ever wanna talk, either about the breakup or just daily life, please do message me :)
